Select target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence for all single-protein targets. Join target_dictionary to target_components on tid, then to component_sequences on component_id. Filter target_dictionary.target_type to 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Return exactly target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence. Order by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence.
